product_tiers.product: Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect
product_tiers.notes: Self-serve from the Products tab (openid, profile, email).
Self-serve from the Products tab (w_member_social): post, comment and like as the authenticated member.

Requires an access request and approval from LinkedIn. Advertising API is requested via the Products tab; approval timelines were not found. Community Management API access details were not verified against docs.

summary: Top-level tier is 'instant' because most agent builders only need member sign-in and posting on the member's behalf, both self-serve in about 15 minutes after a LinkedIn Page admin verifies the app; managing company pages or ads (Community Management / Marketing APIs) is partner_gated and needs a LinkedIn access request.

approval_wait.label: None for open products · Partner programs: not published
approval_wait.notes: Open products (Sign in with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect, Share on LinkedIn) are enabled by self-service. For Advertising API, Sales Navigator and Talent programs approval is required and no timeline was found; Compliance is closed.

prerequisites.notes: Needed to sign in to the Developer Portal.
An app is associated with a Page. Whether a Page is mandatory at creation was not confirmed in the pages checked.
In app Settings click Verify to generate a URL for the Page super admin to approve. The link expires within 30 days.
Commonly requested at app creation; not confirmed in the pages checked.

steps.title: Create the app in the Developer Portal
steps.detail: Create an app, associating it with your LinkedIn Page, and complete the required app details.

steps.title: Verify the app with the Page admin
steps.detail: In the app's Settings tab click Verify and send the generated URL to the Page super admin to approve.

steps.title: Add self-serve products
steps.detail: On the Products tab add 'Sign in with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect' and/or 'Share on LinkedIn'.

steps.title: Configure redirect URLs and store credentials
steps.detail: On the Auth tab add authorized redirect URLs and copy the Client ID and Client Secret into server-side environment variables.

steps.title: Implement the authorization code flow
steps.detail: Use the 3-legged flow with the openid, profile, email scopes for sign-in, and w_member_social for posting.

steps.title: Apply for partner programs if needed
steps.detail: For Advertising API add the product and apply; Sales Navigator (SNAP) and Talent require partner applications.

blockers.issue: Page super admin has not approved the app verification request.
blockers.how_to_resolve: Re-send the verification URL; it expires earlier than 30 days only if an admin denies it, and a denial requires generating a new request.

blockers.issue: You need profile data beyond name, headline, photo and email, or non-posting APIs.
blockers.how_to_resolve: Most permissions need explicit LinkedIn approval via partner programs; Compliance access is closed. Scope the product to open permissions.

blockers.issue: Sign In with LinkedIn v1 product no longer works for new integrations.
blockers.how_to_resolve: Use the OpenID Connect version; v1 was deprecated on August 1, 2023 per a search snippet of LinkedIn's docs.

agent_can_do: Draft the verification request message for the Page admin
Implement the OAuth flow and OpenID Connect ID token handling
Pick the minimal products and scopes for the use case
developer_must_do: Create the app and associate it with a LinkedIn Page
Get a Page super admin to approve verification
Enable products from the Products tab
Submit and follow up on partner program applications

claims_evidence.claim: Open permissions (profile, email via Sign in with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect; w_member_social via Share on LinkedIn) are available to all developers via self-service on the Products tab.
Most other permissions and partner programs require explicit approval from LinkedIn; Compliance access is closed.
Advertising API access must be approved via the Products tab; Sales Navigator (SNAP) and Talent integrations require partner applications.
Page verification: the app's Settings tab generates a URL for a Page super admin to approve; the URL stays valid up to 30 days unless denied.
Sign in with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect uses openid, profile and email scopes.
Sign In with LinkedIn v1 was deprecated on August 1, 2023.
Creating an app requires a Page, a privacy policy URL and a logo.
Product enablement is immediate with no wait.
